dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000qd6b](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000qd6b) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Jul 17 2025 61km SW of Waikabubak. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -10.1374 longitude 119.1803. It impacted 43322 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
